reserveReview.rationale: Same-block reads at XDC block 108767954 (2026-10-27T08:52:54Z) measured 25,407,276.931021 psXDC, 7,471,325.302965 WXDC, and 0.068541 CGO in the three CollateralTokenAdapters (pool ids psXDC, XDC, and CGO resolved through CollateralPoolConfig.getAdapter); the balances equal those measured at block 107486464 on 2026-09-21. The protocol's FathomPriceOracle returned $0.0336463 for XDC and $128.38 for CGO at the same block. Applying Fathom's one-for-one psXDC-as-XDC valuation produced collateral values of $854,860.86, $251,382.45, and $8.80, or 77.275%, 22.724%, and 0.001% after rounding. A log scan of CollateralPoolConfig from block 107486465 through 108767954 returned no events, so no pool was initialized after the earlier exhaustive follow-up and the three enumerated pools remain the full composition.
reserveReview.compositionBasis: Same-block on-chain CollateralTokenAdapter balances and protocol oracle prices at XDC block 108767954
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: Pool identities, balances, and protocol valuation weights are measured at XDC block 108767954. Weights can change after that block, and psXDC retains Fathom's one-for-one XDC valuation because the protocol has no separate psXDC exchange-rate feed.
